environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) operating at Layer 4. Traffic arrives directly to the Flask application on port 8080. No additional middleware or proxy between NLB and application. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 with TLS termination at NLB. Instance IAM role has read-only access to the database volume (EBS). No application-layer filtering is applied by the NLB.
